definition_en: for all time, for a very long time, or constantly
core_image: 一条没有尽头的路一直伸向地平线
scene: 他答应永远记得这一天。He promised to remember that day forever.
sceneCN: 这里 forever 是「永远」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他答应永远记得这一天。

senses.title: For all time
senses.definition: for all time, without end
senses.definitionCN: 一直持续，没有尽头
senses.example: He promised to remember that day forever.
senses.exampleCN: 他答应永远记得这一天。
senses.why: This is the central and oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心也是最古老的义项。

senses.title: A very long time
senses.definition: for a very long time, often in exaggeration
senses.definitionCN: 很长时间，常用于夸张
senses.example: The queue seemed to take forever.
senses.why: Everyday speech stretches eternity into impatience.
senses.whyCN: 日常口语把永恒拉长成不耐烦。

senses.title: Constantly
senses.definition: again and again, all the time
senses.definitionCN: 一次又一次，总是如此
senses.example: She is forever losing her keys.
senses.why: Repetition feels as if it will never stop.
senses.whyCN: 重复让人感觉永远不会停止。

intro.en: Forever is simply for plus ever, joined into one word.
intro.cn: forever 就是 for 加 ever，后来合成一个词。

items.en: Aefre meant ever or always.
items.cn: aefre 意为曾经或永远。

items.en: For ever was written as two words.
items.cn: for ever 当时写作两个词。

items.en: Forever became one word in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: forever 在十七世纪合成一个词。

items.en: It came to mean a very long time.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示很长一段时间。

items.en: It also came to mean constantly.
items.cn: 它也发展出总是的含义。

note.en: Forever is compared with similar-looking words and with words for endless time.
note.cn: 把 forever 与形近词以及表示无尽时间的词作比较。

entries.definition: in a way meant to last

normalIntro.en: Forever stretches a moment until it has no end.
normalIntro.cn: forever 把一个瞬间拉长到没有尽头。

normal.en: He promised to remember that day forever.
normal.cn: 他答应永远记得这一天。

normal.en: The queue seemed to take forever.
She is forever losing her keys.
They promised to stay friends forever.
Nothing lasts forever.

abstract.en: Forever is a promise the future cannot sign.
abstract.cn: 永远是一个未来无法签署的承诺。

abstract.en: Impatience turns five minutes into forever.
abstract.cn: 不耐烦会把五分钟变成永远。

abstract.en: Some memories stay forever young.
abstract.cn: 有些记忆永远年轻。

examples.en: He promised to remember that day forever.
examples.cn: 他答应永远记得这一天。

examples.en: The queue seemed to take forever.
She is forever losing her keys.

dict_mnemonic.text: forever 就是 for（为了）加 ever（任何时候）：为了任何时间，就是永远。

root: 由 for 与 ever 合成，核心义「贯穿所有时间」。

sensesIntro.en: Forever means for all time, a very long time, or constantly.
sensesIntro.cn: forever 意为永远、长久地或总是。

core.en: Time with no wall at the end.
core.cn: 尽头没有墙的时间。

branches.en: The promise has no end.
Waiting feels endless.
The same thing keeps happening.
Endless time and endless repetition share one word.
branches.cn: 无尽时间与无尽重复共用一个词。

branches.en: Real eternity and imagined eternity look alike.
branches.cn: 真实的永恒与想象的永恒看起来一样。

intro.en: Forever gathers a family of ever and always words.
intro.cn: forever 聚拢了一个表示 ever 与 always 的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forever is Germanic; Latin semper, always, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forever 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 semper（总是）只是语义对应词。

items.example: They promised to stay friends forever.
The old spelling writes it for ever.
items.exampleCN: 旧式拼法把它写作两个词。

items.example: Have you ever seen the sea?

items.exampleCN: 需要帮助时随时打电话。

definition_zh: 伪造；锻造；奋勇前进；建立
definition_en: to make a false copy, to shape metal with heat, to move ahead steadily, or to build a relationship
core_image: 炉火通红，铁锤起落，一块金属被敲出形状
scene: 他伪造了父亲的签名。He forged his father's signature.
sceneCN: 这里 forge 是「伪造」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他伪造了父亲的签名。

senses.title: To fake
senses.definition: to make an illegal copy of something
senses.definitionCN: 非法制作某物的副本
senses.example: He forged his father's signature.
senses.why: This is the most familiar modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最熟悉的义项。

senses.title: To shape metal
senses.definition: to shape metal by heating and hammering
senses.definitionCN: 通过加热和锤打使金属成形
senses.example: The blacksmith forged a knife by the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 铁匠在炉火旁锻造了一把刀。
senses.why: This is the original craft sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是原本的工艺义项。

senses.title: To move ahead
senses.definition: to move forward steadily and with effort
senses.definitionCN: 稳步而费力地向前推进
senses.example: The team forged ahead despite the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管下雨，队伍仍然奋勇前进。
senses.why: The image of hammering becomes steady effort.
senses.whyCN: 锤打的意象转化为持续的努力。

senses.title: To build
senses.definition: to build something strong, such as a friendship or plan
senses.definitionCN: 建立牢固的事物，如友谊或计划
senses.example: They forged a lasting friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 他们建立了长久的友谊。
senses.why: What is forged is made strong by effort.
senses.whyCN: 锻造之物因努力而坚固。

intro.en: Forge comes through Old French from a Latin word for a workshop.
intro.cn: forge 经古法语来自拉丁语中表示工坊的词。

items.en: Fabrica meant a workshop or craft.
items.cn: fabrica 意为工坊或手艺。

items.en: Forge named a smithy.
items.cn: forge 指铁匠铺。

items.en: Forgen meant to shape metal.
items.cn: forgen 意为锻造金属。

items.en: The word came to mean to fake documents.
items.cn: 这个词逐渐表示伪造文件。

items.en: Forge ahead came to mean to push forward.
items.cn: forge ahead 逐渐表示向前推进。

note.en: Forge is compared with similar-looking words and with words for faking and shaping.
note.cn: 把 forge 与形近词以及表示伪造和成形的词作比较。

entries.definition: to invent or make something false

normalIntro.en: Forge means to hammer something into shape, whether metal or a lie.
normalIntro.cn: forge 是把东西锤打成形，无论对象是金属还是谎言。

normal.en: He forged his father's signature.
The blacksmith forged a knife by the fire.
normal.cn: 铁匠在炉火旁锻造了一把刀。

normal.en: The team forged ahead despite the rain.
normal.cn: 尽管下雨，队伍仍然奋勇前进。

normal.en: They forged a lasting friendship.
normal.cn: 他们建立了长久的友谊。

normal.en: The document was clearly forged.
normal.cn: 这份文件显然是伪造的。

abstract.en: Fire and patience make metal honest.
abstract.cn: 火与耐心让金属变得诚实。

abstract.en: A lie is forged with the same care as a blade.
abstract.cn: 谎言和刀刃一样需要精心锻造。

abstract.en: Friendships are forged, not found ready-made.
abstract.cn: 友谊是锻造出来的，不是现成捡来的。

examples.en: He forged his father's signature.
The blacksmith forged a knife by the fire.
examples.cn: 铁匠在炉火旁锻造了一把刀。

examples.en: They forged a lasting friendship.
examples.cn: 他们建立了长久的友谊。

dict_mnemonic.text: forge 原指铁匠铺：在炉火里把铁打成想要的形状，后来把假的文件也「打」得像真的。

root: 经古法语 forge（铁匠铺）源自拉丁语 fabrica（工坊），核心义「加热锤打使成形」。

sensesIntro.en: Forge means to fake, to shape metal, to move ahead, or to build.
sensesIntro.cn: forge 意为伪造、锻造、奋勇前进或建立。

core.en: Heat and force give a thing its shape.
core.cn: 热与力赋予事物形状。

branches.en: A false copy is hammered into shape.
Hot metal obeys the hammer.
Effort pushes the team forward.
Friendship is built by repeated effort.
Real shaping and false shaping share one craft.
branches.cn: 真实的成形与虚假的成形共享同一种手艺。

intro.en: Forge builds a family of smithing and faking words.
intro.cn: forge 构成表示锻造与伪造的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forge comes from Latin fabrica; the Latin entries below show that source.
latinIntro.cn: forge 来自拉丁语 fabrica；下面的拉丁条目展示了这一来源。

items.example: The smith can forge a blade.

items.exampleCN: 这家铺子锻造铁制工具。

items.example: The chain was forged by hand.
items.exampleCN: 这条链子是手工锻造的。

latinEntries.example: Fabrica is the Latin source of forge.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fabrica 是 forge 的拉丁语来源。

definition_en: to fail to remember, to leave something behind, to stop thinking about, or to overlook
core_image: 一把钥匙静静躺在桌上，主人已经出了门
scene: 我忘了带钥匙。I forgot to bring my keys.
sceneCN: 这里 forget 是「忘记」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我忘了带钥匙。

senses.title: To fail to remember
senses.definition: to be unable to remember something
senses.definitionCN: 无法记住某事
senses.example: I forgot to bring my keys.
senses.why: This is the central mental sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的心理义项。

senses.title: To leave behind
senses.definition: to leave something somewhere by mistake
senses.definitionCN: 不小心把某物留在某处
senses.example: She forgot her umbrella on the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 她把伞忘在公交车上了。
senses.why: The mind's absence becomes an object's absence.
senses.whyCN: 头脑的缺席变成物品的缺席。

senses.title: To stop thinking
senses.definition: to stop thinking about something on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 有意不再想某事
senses.example: Forget about the argument.
senses.why: Forgetting can be a choice.
senses.whyCN: 忘记也可以是一种选择。

senses.title: To overlook
senses.definition: to fail to consider something important
senses.definitionCN: 未能考虑到重要的事
senses.example: Do not forget the cost of travel.
senses.why: A practical sense of leaving something out.
senses.whyCN: 这是漏掉某事的实用义项。

intro.en: Forget is an old English compound meaning to lose from the mind.
intro.cn: forget 是一个古英语复合词，意为从头脑中失去。

items.en: Forgietan meant to lose from the mind.
items.cn: forgietan 意为从头脑中失去。

items.en: Forgeten kept the same sense.
items.cn: forgeten 保留了相同含义。

items.en: Forgot and forgotten settled as past forms.
items.cn: forgot 与 forgotten 固定为过去形式。

items.en: The sense to leave behind appeared.
items.cn: 忘带义项出现了。

items.en: The polite sense of dismissal developed.
items.cn: 礼貌地表示不再想的义项发展起来。

note.en: Forget is compared with similar-looking words and with words for failing to recall.
note.cn: 把 forget 与形近词以及表示想不起来的词作比较。

entries.definition: to stop being angry with someone

normalIntro.en: To forget is to let something slip out of the mind's pocket.
normalIntro.cn: forget 就是让某物从头脑的口袋里滑出去。

normal.en: I forgot to bring my keys.
She forgot her umbrella on the bus.
normal.cn: 她把伞忘在公交车上了。

normal.en: Forget about the argument.
Do not forget the cost of travel.
I will never forget your kindness.
normal.cn: 我永远不会忘记你的好意。

abstract.en: Forgetting is memory deciding what to keep.
abstract.cn: 遗忘是记忆在决定保留什么。

abstract.en: A forgotten umbrella remembers its owner.
abstract.cn: 被遗忘的伞仍记得它的主人。

abstract.en: Some things are better forgotten on purpose.
abstract.cn: 有些事最好是有意忘掉。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my keys.
She forgot her umbrella on the bus.
examples.cn: 她把伞忘在公交车上了。

examples.en: I will never forget your kindness.
examples.cn: 我永远不会忘记你的好意。

dict_mnemonic.text: forget 的 for 有「离开」的意味，get 是「得到」：得到过的东西离开了头脑，就是忘记。

root: 源自古英语 forgietan（for- 离去 + gietan 抓住），核心义「让记忆从手中滑走」。

sensesIntro.en: Forget means to fail to remember, to leave behind, to stop thinking, or to overlook.
sensesIntro.cn: forget 意为忘记、忘带、不再想或忽略。

core.en: Something slips out of memory and stays out.
core.cn: 某物从记忆中滑出，并留在外面。

branches.en: The fact is no longer found.
The object is left behind.
The thought is set down on purpose.
A detail is left out of the plan.
A missing memory and a missing umbrella feel alike.
branches.cn: 丢失的记忆和丢失的伞感觉相似。

intro.en: Forget builds a family of memory and absence words.
intro.cn: forget 构成表示记忆与缺失的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forget is Germanic; Latin oblivisci, to forget, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forget 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 oblivisci（忘记）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: the act of failing to remember
items.example: Forgetting is part of being human.

definition_en: to stop being angry with someone, to pardon a wrong, to cancel a debt, or to ask politely
core_image: 紧握的拳头慢慢松开，怒气像沙子一样漏掉
scene: 她原谅了他的迟到。She forgave him for being late.
sceneCN: 这里 forgive 是「原谅」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她原谅了他的迟到。

senses.title: To stop being angry
senses.definition: to stop being angry with someone for a wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因某人的过错而不再生气
senses.example: She forgave him for being late.
senses.why: This is the everyday personal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常的人际义项。

senses.title: To pardon
senses.definition: to pardon a serious wrong or crime
senses.definitionCN: 宽恕严重的过错或罪行
senses.example: The king forgave the prisoner.
senses.why: The word can carry the weight of law.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以承载法律的重量。

senses.title: To cancel a debt
senses.definition: to officially cancel money that is owed
senses.definitionCN: 正式取消所欠的钱
senses.example: The bank forgave the loan.
senses.why: A debt can be released like a grudge.
senses.whyCN: 债务可以像怨恨一样被释放。

senses.title: A polite opener
senses.definition: used politely before asking or interrupting
senses.definitionCN: 在提问或打断之前礼貌使用
senses.example: Forgive me, but I have a question.
senses.why: The pardon sense softens everyday speech.
senses.whyCN: 宽恕义项让日常言语变得柔和。

intro.en: Forgive originally meant to give up a claim or a debt.
intro.cn: forgive 最初意为放弃一项要求或债务。

items.en: Forgyfan meant to give up or pardon.
items.cn: forgyfan 意为放弃或宽恕。

items.en: Forgiven kept the sense of pardon.
items.cn: forgiven 保留了宽恕的含义。

items.en: The idea extended from wrongs to debts.
items.cn: 这个概念从过错扩展到债务。

items.en: Forgiveness became a common noun.
items.cn: forgiveness 成为常见名词。

items.en: The polite phrase forgive me developed.
items.cn: 礼貌用语 forgive me 发展起来。

note.en: Forgive is compared with similar-looking words and with words for pardoning.
note.cn: 把 forgive 与形近词以及表示宽恕的词作比较。

entries.definition: to declare someone free of blame

normalIntro.en: To forgive is to open a hand that was holding a grudge.
normalIntro.cn: forgive 就是松开那只攥着怨恨的手。

normal.en: She forgave him for being late.
The king forgave the prisoner.
The bank forgave the loan.
Forgive me, but I have a question.
It is hard to forgive a lie.

abstract.en: Forgiveness frees two people at once.
abstract.cn: 宽恕同时释放两个人。

abstract.en: To forgive is not to forget.
abstract.cn: 原谅并不等于忘记。

abstract.en: A forgiven debt leaves no shadow.
abstract.cn: 被免除的债务不会留下阴影。

examples.en: She forgave him for being late.
The king forgave the prisoner.
It is hard to forgive a lie.

dict_mnemonic.text: forgive 就是 for（彻底）加 give（给出去）：把怨恨彻底给出去，自己就轻松了。

root: 源自古英语 forgyfan（彻底给予、放弃），核心义「放下追讨，把怨恨或债务给出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Forgive means to stop being angry, to pardon, to cancel a debt, or to speak politely.
sensesIntro.cn: forgive 意为原谅、宽恕、免除或请原谅。

core.en: Letting go of a claim against someone.
core.cn: 放弃对某人的追讨。

branches.en: The anger is put down.
A serious wrong is pardoned.
A debt is crossed out.
A polite word softens a request.
branches.cn: 礼貌用语让请求变柔和。

branches.en: Personal anger and public pardon share one release.
branches.cn: 私人怒气与公开赦免共享同一种释放。

intro.en: Forgive builds a family of pardon and patience words.
intro.cn: forgive 构成表示宽恕与耐心的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forgive is Germanic; Latin ignoscere, to pardon, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forgive 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 ignoscere（宽恕）只是语义对应词。

items.exampleCN: 这是一个可以原谅的错误。

definition_zh: 叉子；岔口；用叉叉起；分叉
definition_en: a tool with prongs for eating, a place where a road divides, to lift with a fork, or to divide into branches
core_image: 一只手握住叉柄，三根叉齿稳稳扎进食物
scene: 桌上有一把银叉。There is a silver fork on the table.
sceneCN: 这里 fork 是「叉子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：桌上有一把银叉。

senses.title: An eating tool
senses.definition: a tool with a handle and prongs used for eating
senses.definitionCN: 带柄和叉齿的进食工具
senses.example: There is a silver fork on the table.
senses.why: This is the most familiar sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最熟悉的义项。

senses.title: A divided road
senses.definition: a place where a road or river divides
senses.definitionCN: 道路或河流分开的地方
senses.example: Turn left at the fork.
senses.why: The shape of prongs becomes a map shape.
senses.whyCN: 叉齿的形状变成了地图上的形状。

senses.title: To lift with a fork
senses.definition: to lift or move food with a fork
senses.definitionCN: 用叉子举起或移动食物
senses.example: He forked a piece of potato.
senses.exampleCN: 他用叉子叉起一块土豆。
senses.why: The noun turns into an action.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为动作。

senses.title: To divide
senses.definition: to divide into two or more branches
senses.definitionCN: 分成两个或更多分支
senses.example: The river forks near the village.
senses.why: Moving things can split like a fork.
senses.whyCN: 运动的事物也能像叉子一样分开。

intro.en: Fork came from a Latin word for a pitchfork.
intro.cn: fork 来自拉丁语中表示干草叉的词。

items.en: Furca meant a pitchfork.
items.cn: furca 意为干草叉。

items.en: Forca entered as a farm tool.
items.cn: forca 作为农具进入英语。

items.en: Fork named a table utensil.
items.cn: fork 开始指餐桌上的餐具。

items.en: The road sense appeared.
items.cn: 岔路的义项出现了。

items.en: The verb came to mean to divide or lift.
items.cn: 动词义发展为分开或叉起。

note.en: Fork is compared with similar-looking words and with words for utensils and branches.
note.cn: 把 fork 与形近词以及表示餐具和分支的词作比较。

entries.definition: a tool for eating soft food
a part that divides from a main line

normalIntro.en: A fork holds food and also shows where a path splits.
normalIntro.cn: 叉子既能叉住食物，也能显示道路在哪里分开。

normal.en: There is a silver fork on the table.
Turn left at the fork.
He forked a piece of potato.
normal.cn: 他用叉子叉起一块土豆。

normal.en: The river forks near the village.
Use a garden fork for the soil.

abstract.en: A fork is a small decision made of metal.
abstract.cn: 叉子是用金属做成的一个小决定。

abstract.en: Every road fork asks a silent question.
abstract.cn: 每个岔路都在无声地提问。

abstract.en: The same shape serves the table and the map.
abstract.cn: 同一种形状同时服务于餐桌和地图。

examples.en: There is a silver fork on the table.
Turn left at the fork.
The river forks near the village.

dict_mnemonic.text: fork 的形状就是「一分为几」：餐桌上的叉子有几个齿，路上的岔口也分成几条。

root: 源自拉丁语 furca（干草叉），核心义「带齿的分叉工具或形状」。

sensesIntro.en: Fork means an eating tool, a road divide, to lift with a fork, or to split.
sensesIntro.cn: fork 意为叉子、岔口、用叉叉起或分叉。

core.en: One handle splitting into several points.
core.cn: 一个手柄分成几个尖点。

branches.en: The prongs lift the food.
The road splits in two.
The hand uses the tool.
The river divides like prongs.

senses.why: Decades are named by the tens digit.
senses.whyCN: 年代用十位数字来命名。

intro.en: Forty is an old Germanic compound for four tens.
intro.cn: forty 是一个表示四个十的古老日耳曼语复合词。

items.en: Feowertig meant four tens.
items.cn: feowertig 意为四个十。

items.en: The form became fourty.
items.cn: 词形演变为 fourty。

items.en: The spelling forty dropped the u.
items.cn: 拼写 forty 去掉了字母 u。

items.en: The forties named a decade and an age range.
items.cn: forties 指一个年代和年龄段。

items.en: Fortieth became its ordinal form.
items.cn: fortieth 成为它的序数形式。

note.en: Forty is compared with similar-looking words and with other number words.
note.cn: 把 forty 与形近词以及其他数词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Forty is four tens standing in a row.
normalIntro.cn: forty 就是四个十排成一排。

normal.en: There are forty seats in the classroom.
normal.cn: 这间教室有四十个座位。

normal.en: He wrote the book in his forties.
normal.cn: 他在四十多岁时写了这本书。

normal.en: The song was popular in the forties.
normal.cn: 这首歌在四十年代很流行。

normal.en: The trip took forty minutes.
normal.cn: 这趟行程用了四十分钟。

normal.en: Forty percent of the class agreed.
normal.cn: 班上百分之四十的人同意。

abstract.en: Forty is the age when counting changes direction.
abstract.cn: 四十岁是计数改变方向的年纪。

abstract.en: Four tens can hold a whole decade.
abstract.cn: 四个十可以装下一整个年代。

abstract.en: Numbers are small doors into time.
abstract.cn: 数字是通往时间的小门。

examples.en: There are forty seats in the classroom.
examples.cn: 这间教室有四十个座位。

examples.en: He wrote the book in his forties.
examples.cn: 他在四十多岁时写了这本书。

examples.en: The trip took forty minutes.
examples.cn: 这趟行程用了四十分钟。

dict_mnemonic.text: forty 就是 four 加 -ty（十个）：四个十，四十；加上 -ies 就成了一整个四十年代。

root: 源自古英语 feowertig（四个十），核心义「四乘十的数目」。

sensesIntro.en: Forty means the number 40, the age range, or the 1940s.
sensesIntro.cn: forty 意为四十、四十多岁或四十年代。

core.en: Four groups of ten counted together.
core.cn: 四组十合在一起计数。

branches.en: The count reaches forty.
A life enters its forties.
A decade takes the name.
branches.cn: 一个年代得到这个名称。

branches.en: Quantity and age share the number.
branches.cn: 数量与年龄共享这个数字。

branches.en: The forties can mean age or history.
branches.cn: forties 既可以指年龄，也可以指历史。

intro.en: Forty belongs to the family of tens and ordinals.
intro.cn: forty 属于十位数与序数词的家族。

latinIntro.en: Forty is Germanic; Latin quadraginta, forty, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forty 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 quadraginta（四十）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The house was built in the forties.
items.exampleCN: 这栋房子建于四十年代。
会议持续了四十五分钟。
百分之四十的人投了赞成票。

items.example: She worked there for forty years.
items.exampleCN: 她在那里工作了四十年。
